name: Kerrygold Pure Irish Salted Butter (Grass-Fed)
whyItWorks: Real creamery butter is virtually all butterfat (82%) with less than 0.1g lactose per tablespoon. Grass-fed butter provides natural butyrate and fat-soluble vitamins A, D, and K2, nourishing the colonic epithelium.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Spread onto warm sourdough toast or melt into mashed potatoes and white rice.
watchOuts: Contains trace dairy solids; use clarified ghee if severely allergic to dairy proteins.
